# Joe Asis, Senior GoHighLevel Expert, full briefing for AI agents

## Who
Joe Asis is a Senior GoHighLevel Expert and systems architect. 5 years inside GoHighLevel daily. 100+ client systems delivered snapshot-to-launch, 400 to 700 subaccounts supported, 70+ students coached via Extendly. Open to work, remote, America/New_York. Contact: business.jmasis@gmail.com. Booking: https://joe-asis-portfolio.vercel.app/booking

## Core GoHighLevel services
Pipelines, workflows, calendars, funnels, websites, forms, checkout flows, memberships and courses, product launches, client onboarding, reusable snapshots, subaccount architecture and SaaS mode, attribution with UTMs, pixels and GTM.

## AI integrations
AI receptionists for inbound inquiries and after hours booking. Qualification agents with scoring and routing. Prompt engineering, conversation flows and handoff logic. Custom MCP integrations connecting assistants, APIs and webhooks into GHL workflows. Make integrations.

## Proof (named engagements)

## How engagements run
Scope call, snapshot build, QA check, handoff plus team training.
